How about drummers? Bass players
and drummers, you know, they're always allied very closely,
and there's always been, you know, on one hand a very tight
knit thing; on the other hand, there can be a friction.

Well, the drummers of today, there are
several fine drummers of today, say, Jackie Williams or
Connie
Tommy Kay, or Red Baer. There are so many I couldn't even

think of, but the drummers of today didn't get the experience of the early years of show business, because the drummers had to play for dance groups, chorus girls, et cetera, performers that required special effects, and the young drummers of the day hadn't -- didn't have that workshop to rely on.
